_comment: English for the payment-gateway configuration forms (app/Payments/*/form()), which the admin renders at Payment Config, and for the abort()/throw messages those gateways raise. Same mechanism as server-admin.en-US.json: values are Laravel translation keys wrapped in __(), and server-messages.mjs appends each new key to resources/lang/zh-CN.json (key => original Chinese) so the user-facing checkout keeps its Chinese wording. Admin form labels are English-only in practice because resources/lang has no Chinese-mode override that predates this file.
API接口所在网址(包含最后的斜杠): Base URL of the API endpoint (include the trailing slash)
个人设置中的API KEY(非商店设置中的): The API KEY in Personal Settings (not the one in Store Settings)
商户 ID，填写您在 Account Settings 中得到的 ID: Merchant ID — enter the ID from your Account Settings
通知密钥，填写您在 Merchant Settings 中自行设置的值: Notification secret — enter the value you set in Merchant Settings
填写您的货币代码（大写），建议与 Merchant Settings 中的值相同: Enter your currency code in uppercase; it should match the value in Merchant Settings
支付类型，如: alipay, wxpay, qqpay: Payment type, e.g. alipay, wxpay, qqpay
支付站点根地址，例如：https://pay.xxxxxx.com: Payment site root URL, e.g. https://pay.xxxxxx.com
必填：alipay 或 wxpay；MAPI 不允许留空: Required: alipay or wxpay; MAPI does not allow it to be empty
支付接口网络异常或返回内容无法解析: The payment gateway network error or its response could not be parsed
接口下单成功，但没有返回 qrcode、urlscheme 或 payurl: The order was created, but no qrcode, urlscheme or payurl was returned
EPay URL 格式错误: The EPay URL format is invalid
Epusdt 后台的 pid: The pid from the Epusdt dashboard
Epusdt 后台的 secret_key: The secret_key from the Epusdt dashboard
留空时进入 GMPay 选择链路界面，填写时按该网络直接发起订单: Leave empty to let the user choose a GMPay network, or enter one to place the order on that network directly
Paytaro 应用的 App ID；: The App ID of the Paytaro application;
Paytaro 应用的 App Secret；: The App Secret of the Paytaro application;
Paytaro 商户后台 → 应用管理 → 应用 → 付款方式 → 复制对应支付: Paytaro merchant dashboard -> App Management -> Application -> Payment Methods -> copy the UUID of the payment method (add one payment config per method)
Paytaro：请在支付配置中填写支付方式 UUID: Paytaro: please enter the payment method UUID in the payment config
Paytaro 网络异常，请稍后重试: A Paytaro network error occurred, please try again later
请使用符合ISO 4217标准的三位字母，例如GBP: Use a three-letter ISO 4217 code, for example GBP
例如可设置为“联系方式”，以便及时与客户取得联系: For example, set it to "Contact Details" so you can reach the customer quickly
绑定微信支付商户的APPID: The APPID of the bound WeChat Pay merchant
弹窗显码模式：用户在本站页面内直接扫码 / 转账付款，不经过 Paytaro 收: QR-in-dialog mode: the customer scans or transfers directly on this page instead of at the Paytaro checkout. To open an account or enable a payment method, contact @paytaro
开户 / 开通支付方式请联系：<a href=\"https://t.me/sm: To open an account or enable a payment method, contact @smogate
_not_translated_note: Fragments that are operands of a PHP `.` concatenation with a runtime value. server-messages.mjs rewrites only self-contained literals, because wrapping one half of a concatenation would leave an English fragment glued to a Chinese one (`'Paytaro:' . $status . '）'`). Each is rewritten as a whole expression by admin-i18n/payments-concat.mjs, and listed here so this tool never re-wraps the pieces.
